title: Nazca Lines Hidden Water Theory

scenes.text: Over 800 giant geoglyphs stretch across Peru’s desert.
scenes.query: aerial view of Nazca Lines sunrise

scenes.text: Recent LiDAR scans show subtle depressions beneath many lines.
Scientists found a correlation between line clusters and ancient aquifer locations.
The twist: the lines may have been a massive water‑management map, not just ceremonial art.

scenes.query2: overlay of ancient map on desert

scenes.text: Follow for a new mystery every day.

description: The Nazca Lines have baffled researchers for centuries. New data suggests they could be ancient guides to underground water sources. Dive deeper into this fresh perspective and more unsolved wonders.
